title: 歩行者用信号機
description: 横断歩道の端に立つ歩行者用信号機と支柱です。フランジ付きの丸柱、上下2灯の灯器箱とひさし、取付バンドと腕、背面の接続箱を造形しています。下の青緑レンズは点灯（発光材質）、上の赤レンズは消灯状態です。人形の図記号、押しボタン、待ち時間表示、配線、信号の切替動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.320 × 3.030 × 0.670 m、4,424三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A pedestrian signal head on its own pole at the end of a crosswalk. It models the flanged round pole, two stacked lamp housings with hood visors, mounting bands and arms, and a rear junction box. The lower blue-green lens is lit using an emissive material and the upper red lens is unlit. Walking-figure pictograms, push buttons, countdown indicators, wiring and signal switching are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.320 × 3.030 × 0.670 m; 4,424 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
